key_insight: Marformer predicts conditional marginals directly from partial observations, enabling missing-data inference and value-of-information estimation without learning the full joint distribution.
engineering_relevance: This offers a fast, single-pass alternative for decision systems that must act under incomplete data, with applications in active sensing, diagnosis, and annotation workflows.
method: Transformer encodes each variable’s marginal distribution and updates it via attention to other variables.
Trained to infer missing-variable distributions from any observed subset, similar to masked prediction.
Avoids explicit generative modeling of the full data-generating process.
evidence_signal: The model was tested on Bayesian networks, discretized multivariate Gaussians, structured annotation data, and a real annotation dataset, where it matched or outperformed baselines and was substantially faster.
watch_item: Performance may depend on the representativeness of training patterns of missingness, so robustness to shifts in observation patterns should be checked.
paper_title: Marformer: A Transformer for Predicting Missing Data Distributions
